items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I called Norman, and I said, 'Hey, Norman, you put out that record, right?' ... So I got a check from Norman; he gave me seventy dollars.

ctx.x: Well, how did you meet Norman and what do you remember about...?
Oh, I was with Bean then. The first night we played at Long Beach, that was the first night we hit in California. And Norman Granz came up and heard Bean
